items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: he had me, Eddie Pearson, Joe Phillips, Leo Dejon, Elliot Taylor, and Arthur Dudley... that was his new band

ctx.x: We'll put it on the next tape. You got time for one another half hour, huh? Yeah. Then I'll take you to the other building and run on down then. Oh, back to Piran. Who played piano with him when you were with him?

Well, when I was with him, he had a new band. See, he had got rid of Pete and all of that bunch. See, he had me, Eddie Pearson, Joe Phillips, Leo Dejon, Elliot Taylor, and Arthur Dudley, and Alavretta, Alexandra of piano. Oh, yeah. Sales, and Simon. See, that was his new band, you see.
Alfred Williams, what number reel is this?

items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1960-04-30
items.q: when I first started playing, consists of me, P. Ron, Lil' Allegrette Alexander, Eddie Pearson on trombone, Joe Phillips, Leo Dejon, Sales, Arthur Durden, Ellia Taylor, and Simon Moreira on the page.

ctx.x: How did Sales rate in those days? He was a nice, fine guitar player. I just wondered who would be among the best guitar players in town. Oh yeah, he was fine, yes indeed.

He always was a musician, you see. He learned the right way. Oh yeah, a musician. That's what I did. He was great, good. Always have been. What about P-Rom's band? P-Rom's band? I played with P-Rom's band from 32 to 35. I played with P-Rom's band. I played with P-Rom's band. I played with P-Rom's band. I played with with Song that was after that. He broke up the band.
